{{Quote|As for myself, were I to find myself stranded halfway between two galaxies, I'd simply shut down my intelligence and set my power consumption for millennial hibernation.|EV-9T9|<ref name="Lightsider" />}}
'''EV-9T9''' was the trusted servant droid of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Kam Solusar]].

==Biography==
[[File:EV-9D9-BYOR2D2-20.png|thumb|left|75px|EV-9T9 was an EV-series droid]]
Created at some point prior to [[25 BBY/Legends|25 BBY]], EV-9T9 accompanied Kam Solusar to [[Anoth/Legends|Anoth]] aboard the ''[[Starfield Roamer]]'' after the latter's father, [[Ranik Solusar]], was slain by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]]. EV-9T9 would stay by Kam's side as the Jedi embarked on a thirty-five [[Standard year/Legends|year]] odyssey beyond [[The galaxy/Legends|the known galaxy]] in order to remain hidden from the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. During such time, EV-9T9 began displaying some degradation to his systems: it took longer for the droid to come online after being deactivated, it did not always confirm that it understood its orders and it developed a unique sense of humour.

EV-9T9 and Kam eventually returned to the known galaxy amidst the start [[Operation Shadow Hand]]. They were only three days away from reaching [[Shabook]] when a [[Victory-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Victory-class Star Destroyer]] caught the ''Starfield Roamer'' in a [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beam]] and captured Kam and EV. Being the property of an escaped [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], EV-9T9 was taken with Kam to [[Bast Castle]] on the planet [[Vjun/Legends|Vjun]] so that it could be inspected by the [[Dark Side Elite]]. After being dismantled by the [[Darksider]], [[Zasm Katth]], EV-9T9 permanently shutdown, allowing Zasm to have unrestricted access to its [[Memory bank/Legends|memory banks]].<ref name="Lightsider" />

===Legacy===
{{Quote|Here you are, sir. There's 170,000 hours of pertinent information... fully indexed, of course."<br />"Thank you, DIS-M12. Toss everything into the furnace on your way out.|A DIS-M12 interrogator droid providing Zasm Katth's with EV-9T9's memory banks|<ref name="Lightsider" />}}
Once Zasm was finished with EV-9T9, he had a [[DIS-M12 interrogator droid]] dispose of what remained of the servant droid's body into a furnace. The information that Zasm garnered from EV-9T9's extensive memory banks provided the Dark Side Elite with critical information about Kam Solusar's history and the fate of his family. This, alongside [[Umak Leth]]'s [[Mind Splitter]], allowed [[Sedriss QL]] to successfully break Kam Solusar's will and have him fall to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|Dark Side]].<ref name="Lightsider" />

==Behind the scenes==
EV-9T9 was created by [[Tom Veitch]] for the cancelled ''[[Lightsider (story)|Lightsider]]'' storyline, which was meant to explore the origins of Kam Solusar and bridge the gap between ''[[Star Wars: Dark Empire]]'' and ''[[Star Wars: Dark Empire II]]''. In [[2023]], two unreleased manuscripts of ''Lightsider'' from 1996 and 2009 were obtained by author [[Joseph Bongiorno]] and released as an online PDF containing both on his website starwarstimeline.net.<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://www.starwarstimeline.net/latest_news.htm|text=Lightsider Online Release|work=StarWarsTimeline Expanded Universe News|quote="In case you missed it, here is the PDF for the Tom Veitch story, Lightsider, a lost EU work that takes place between Dark Empire I and II. Click on the title here or on the right column to download Tom Veitch's unpublished, previously lost bridge story between Dark Empires I and II" - Joseph Bongiorno.|archivedate=20231209175121}}</ref>
